scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run wait-for-backend && npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint -w backend -- --fix && npm run lint -w frontend -- --fix
